steps.message:
You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository python-trio/trio.

Problem Statement:
Add tool to keep test-requirements in sync with pre-commit

In this pull request, we add a local pre-commit hook tool to keep the tool versions in `test-requirements.txt` in sync with the equivalent versions in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` automatically, meaning pre-commit.ci automatic updates are more seamless and there can never be cases where the test versions don't match the pre-commit versions.

<!--
I have previously advocated for not disabling the automatic pre-commit updates, because I think it's important to keep the tooling up to date, and in particular for the case of ruff rule changes, version differences can (or at least used to, they are being more stable now) yield wildly different results. My logic was that pre-commit tooling changes should be done as soon as possible and not as a part of other pull requests. I could see a case where once people see this pull request, they argue we should disable the automatic pre-commit updates to avoid the problem this is avoiding.
-->

## Task Budget (Session terminates when any budget is exhausted)
- Time allowance: 5.0 minutes
- Tool calls allowance: 70 calls
- Max loop iterations: 150 turns

## Execution Environment Rules
- Single command timeout: 180 seconds (commands exceeding this fail without ending the session)
- Command output limit: 5000 characters
- File view limit: 150 lines per read_file call
- File character limit: 10000 characters per read_file call
- Environment is offline (no network/PyPI access). All repository and test dependencies are ALREADY pre-installed. Do NOT attempt to run pip install or download packages.

## Instructions:
0. All source code is under `/workspace`. Do NOT search outside `/workspace` (e.g. `/usr/`, `/wheels/`, system site-packages). If imports fail, the issue is in the source code under `/workspace`, not in missing system packages.
1. Analyze the problem statement and any provided hints carefully to identify all requested script paths, CLI subcommands, or Python modules.
2. Inspect existing codebase conventions and test files before making edits.
3. Verify your implementation using targeted tests or inline assertions before submitting.
4. Call submit_patch only after your implementation is complete and verified.
5. As your final action, you must return a text-only response reporting your completion to terminate the session.
## Code Intelligence Tools
This repository has pre-built code graph and embedding data. Use these tools for fast, targeted navigation:
- `search_similar_code(query)`: Find semantically similar functions/classes by keyword.
- `get_code_neighbors(node)`: Find callers, callees, and definitions related to a symbol.
- `get_code_subgraph(nodes)`: Get the induced subgraph for a set of symbols.

{"status": "ok", "stdout": "ci:
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_schedule: weekly
  submodules: false
  # pip-compile requires internet, regenerate-files may get cache
  # issues in CI, so they're run in check.sh
  skip: [pip-compile, regenerate-files]

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v5.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-toml
      - id: check-merge-conflict
      - id: mixed-line-ending
      - id: check-case-conflict
      - id: sort-simple-yaml
        files: .pre-commit-config.yaml
  - repo: https://github.com/psf/black-pre-commit-mirror
    rev: 25.1.0
    hooks:
      - id: black
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.11.8
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        types: [file]
        types_or: [python, pyi, toml]
        args: ["--show-fixes"]
  - repo: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
    rev: v2.4.1
    hooks:
      - id: codespell
        additional_dependencies:
          # tomli needed on 3.10. tomllib is available in stdlib on 3.11+
          - tomli
  - repo: https://github.com/adhtruong/mirrors-typos
    rev: v1.32.0
    hooks:
      - id: typos
  - repo: https://github.com/sphinx-contrib/sphinx-lint
    rev: v1.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: sphinx-lint
  - repo: https://github.com/woodruffw/zizmor-pre-commit
    rev: v1.6.0
    hooks:
      - id: zizmor
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: regenerate-files
        name: regenerate generated files
        language: python
        entry: python src/trio/_tools/gen_exports.py
        pass_filenames: false
        additional_dependencies: ["astor", "attrs", "black", "ruff"]
        files: ^src\/trio\/_core\/(_run|(_i(o_(common|epoll|kqueue|windows)|nstrumentation)))\.py$
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv-pre-commit
    rev: 0.7.2
    hooks:
      # Compile requirements
      - id: pip-compile
        name: uv pip-compile test-requirements.in
        args: [
          "--universal",
          "--python-version=3.9",
          "test-requirements.in",
          "-o",
          "test-requirements.txt"]
        files: ^test-requirements\.(in|txt)$
      - id: pip-compile
        name: uv pip-compile docs-requirements.in
        args: [
          "--universal",
          "--python-version=3.11",
          "docs-requirements.in",
          "-o",
          "docs-requirements.txt"]
        files: ^docs-requirements\.(in|txt)$
", "stderr": "", "exit_code": 0}

FILES: /workspace/src/trio/_tools/sync_pre_commit.py:1-100 (new file), /workspace/.pre-commit-config.yaml:1-80
ROOT CAUSE: There is no tool to automatically synchronize tool versions between `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and `test-requirements.txt`.
CHANGE: 
1. Create a new tool `src/trio/_tools/sync_pre_commit.py` that parses `.pre-commit-config.yaml` for repository revisions (e.g., black, ruff, codespell, typos, zizmor) and updates the corresponding versions in `test-requirements.in` (or `test-requirements.txt` via `pip-compile` if preferred, but `.in` is the source of truth).
2. Add a local pre-commit hook to `.pre-commit-config.yaml` that runs this sync tool.
TEST: Create a test case that modifies a version in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and verify it is reflected in the requirements file after running the sync tool.

(Note: Since the user wants the tool added and the issue describes a "local pre-commit hook tool", creating a script in `src/trio/_tools/` is consistent with `gen_exports.py`.)

{"status": "ok", "filepath": "src/trio/_tools/sync_pre_commit.py", "content": "import yaml
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def sync():
    pre_commit_file = Path(".pre-commit-config.yaml")
    requirements_file = Path("test-requirements.in")

    if not pre_commit_file.exists():
        print(f"Error: {pre_commit_file} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    if not requirements_file.exists():
        print(f"Error: {requirements_file} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    with open(pre_commit_file, "r") as f:
        config = yaml.safe_load(f)

    # Mapping of repo URL fragments to package names in test-requirements.in
    # We only care about packages we actually want to pin versions for.
    package_map = {
        "black-pre-commit-mirror": "black",
        "ruff-pre-commit": "ruff",
        "codespell-project/codespell": "codespell",
        "mirrors-typos": "typos",
        "zizmor-pre-commit": "zizmor",
    }

    updates = {}
    for repo in config.get("repos", []):
        repo_url = repo.get("repo", "")
        rev = repo.get("rev")
        if not rev:
            continue
        
        for fragment, package in package_map.items():
            if fragment in repo_url:
                # Clean 'v' prefix from version if present (e.g., v0.11.8 -> 0.11.8)
                version = rev[1:] if rev.startswith("v") else rev
                updates[package] = version
                break

    if not updates:
        print("No matching tool versions found in .pre-commit-config.yaml")
        return

    with open(requirements_file, "r") as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    new_lines = []
    changed = False
    for line in lines:
        original_line = line
        for package, version in updates.items():
            # Match package name at start of line or after space, 
            # and handle optional existing version constraints.
            # This regex looks for the package name and replaces the version constraint if it exists,
            # or adds it if it doesn't, while preserving environment markers.
            pattern = rf"^(\s*{package}(?:\s*>=?\s*[\d\.]+)?)(\s*;.*)?$"
            match = re.match(pattern, line.strip())
            if match:
                marker = match.group(2) if match.group(2) else ""
                line = f"{package} == {version}{marker}\n"
                changed = True
                break
        new_lines.append(line)

    if changed:
        with open(requirements_file, "w") as f:
            f.writelines(new_lines)
        print("Updated test-requirements.in")
    else:
        print("No updates needed for test-requirements.in")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sync()", "start_line": 1, "end_line": 77, "total_lines": 77, "is_truncated": false}
